observations.description: Rocky mountain terrain with sparse vegetation, snowy and windy weather, temperature around -6°C.
Minimal shelter options with some rocky overhangs, one providing adequate protection from wind and snow.
Limited water availability from melting snow, slightly improved due to increased snow melt.
Sparse food availability, mainly lichens and small rodents.
Wildlife includes hardy mountain goats and more active predatory birds due to clearing skies.
Danger level moderately high due to harsh weather conditions and scarce resources.
Environmental note: Weather showing signs of slight improvement, potential for clearer skies in the following days.
Sparse forest with rocky clearings, slightly warmer at -1°C, with light snow flurries.
Improved shelter options with rocky overhangs and fallen trees offering better protection.
Moderate water availability from more accessible streams due to melting snow.
Slightly improved food availability with more sightings of small rodents and some edible roots.
Increased activity of predatory birds, mountain goats more visible.
Danger level moderate with improved resources but active predators.
Environmental shift note: Weather might clear slightly, with potential reduction in snow flurries.
